free.question: Is this tool really free?
free.answer: Yes, Starry AI Navigator is completely free and open source! You can use it for personal and commercial projects without any licensing fees. You can fork, copy, modify, and distribute it without any restrictions.

apiKey.question: Do I need to provide API Keys?
apiKey.answer: No! We use Cloudflare Workers AI's free Embedding models, so you don't need to provide any API Keys. Just authorize through GitHub OAuth to start using.

security.question: Is my GitHub Token secure?
security.answer: Absolutely secure. We employ multiple security measures: GitHub Tokens are not stored on the client side; backend uses them immediately and discards them; secure storage using Cloudflare Secrets; all communications forced HTTPS; strict adherence to OAuth 2.0 security standards.

accuracy.question: How accurate is the AI search?
accuracy.answer: Our goal is to achieve over 70% first-screen click rate. By combining AI semantic search with precise filtering, even vague descriptions can quickly find relevant repositories. The system continuously learns and optimizes based on your search history.

capacity.question: How many Stars can I search?
capacity.answer: Theoretically unlimited! The system supports: automatic full sync of all Stars after first authorization; daily automatic incremental sync of new Stars; vector search based, better performance with more data; response time always under 2 seconds.

searchTypes.question: What search features are available?
searchTypes.answer: We provide two complementary search methods: AI Smart Search: natural language descriptions like "Go image compression library"; Precise Filtering: filter by language, star count, starred time, license, etc.; Hybrid Search: combine both methods for most accurate results; Real-time Results: search as you type, no waiting.

deployment.question: How to deploy my own instance?
deployment.answer: Deployment is simple, you just need to: 1. Fork the project to your GitHub; 2. Create D1 database and Vectorize index in Cloudflare; 3. Configure GitHub OAuth app; 4. Deploy to Cloudflare Pages; 5. Run database migrations. See deployment documentation for detailed steps.

cost.question: What's the running cost?
cost.answer: Almost zero! We fully utilize Cloudflare's free tier: Cloudflare Pages: free hosting; Cloudflare Workers: free 100,000 requests/day; D1 database: free 100,000 reads/writes/day; Vectorize: free 300,000 queries/month; Workers AI: free 10,000 requests/day. For personal use, it's completely within the free quota.

contribute.question: How to contribute and provide feedback?
contribute.answer: Contributions are welcome! You can submit Issues, Pull Requests, or help improve documentation on GitHub. The project follows standard open source contribution guidelines.
